key_insight: A single-location wave time series can enable reconstruction of a nonlinear wave field and forecasting of extreme waves driven by self-focusing soliton dynamics.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce sensing requirements for monitoring and forecasting extreme waves in settings consistent with its unidirectional wave assumptions.
method: Combine deep learning and compressed sensing to reconstruct waves from sparse observations.
Exploit self-similarity in the unidirectional nonlinear wave evolution equation.
Use reconstructed wave fields to forecast rogue-wave formation.
evidence_signal: Forecasts based on point observations from controlled water-wave tank experiments showed excellent agreement with measurements of the fully evolved wave field.
watch_item: Performance in noisy, multidirectional ocean conditions is not established by the controlled tank results described in the abstract.
paper_title: Reconstruction and Forecast of Extreme Waves from a Single Observation
